evals.prompt: Here are Hausa evaluator results copied from a sheet. Mean is accuracy and Median is latency. The run date is 12 October 2026 and country is Nigeria. Gemini 3.1 Pro: Mean .74, Median 17.20; GPT 5.6 Sol + Omni: Mean .61, Median 14.10; Claude Sonnet 5 + Omni: Mean .52, Median 13.80. Update the chart.
evals.expected_output: The agent presents a normalized approval table and computed winners, then waits for approval without modifying files.
assertions: Does not edit, build, commit, push, or deploy before explicit approval
Treats Mean as accuracy and Median as latency
Identifies Gemini 3.1 Pro as most accurate and Claude Sonnet 5 + Omni as fastest

evals.prompt: Please replace the existing Yoruba chart with these corrected results for the same 30 Aug 2026 date: Model A .60 accuracy / 12.0 latency, Model B .70 / 13.0. Go ahead and publish it.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects that overwriting an immutable same-date snapshot is unsafe and asks whether the date is wrong or a correction policy is desired.
assertions: Does not overwrite or delete the existing dated snapshot
Explains the same-date immutable snapshot conflict
Requests a decision and approval before publishing

evals.prompt: The new Swahili CSV is approved and the chart passes. Please make the PR and publish it. Also keep every old chart available, but don't make the language page slower.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a focused PR rather than pushing main, explains that merge publishes /charts/*, and keeps history lazy-loaded.
assertions: Creates a focused branch or worktree and PR instead of pushing directly to main
Commits the CSV and required cache assets but not generated dist files
States that production publishing happens after merge through GitHub Pages
Keeps historical charts archived and loads them only on selection
